# FuelingSense

> FuelingSense is a metabolic profiler and race fuelling calculator for endurance athletes. From short all-out efforts (cycling: a 20-second sprint and a 5-minute effort; running: a 20-second sprint and 3- and 6-minute efforts) and body composition it estimates VO2max, VLamax, LT1 and LT2, training zones, fat and carbohydrate use by intensity, and a race fuelling plan, without blood lactate. Cycling and running. Built by Dr Graeme Stewart (biochemist, former pro triathlete); operated by Stewart Sports Limited.

## Pages

- [Method](https://www.fueling-sense.com/method): protocol, model, validation and limits
